Internal brief (KPIs): monitor On‑time % to DC (SLA), % of Lenton shipments delayed >+1d, % delayed >+2d, diversion rate (% of post‑09/06 vol diverted), RCC receiving utilization & queue length, and Tier‑1 SKU fulfillment rate.

Operational levers: on Amber — re‑run optimizer and attempt live diversions for Tier‑1 within available spare capacity, deploy temp labor/extended shifts on flagged RCC days, and smooth/defer Wave‑3 receipts; on Red — prioritize and book premium capacity for Tier‑1, defer non‑urgent loads, and escalate immediately to Regional Logistics Manager + Account Team to approve targeted premium spend and customs/trade interventions.  
Client‑ready wording (short): “We will monitor on‑time, Lenton delay bands (>+1d and >+2d) and diversion rates in real time; note upfront that a subset of Lenton flows may see >+1 day delays during week‑1 after 6 Sept. If Lenton delays materially exceed expectations we will attempt targeted diversions for Tier‑1 SKUs and deploy premium lanes and temp labor as needed, and will provide updated ETAs and an estimated cost impact within 4 hours of escalation (outcome dependent on live capacity and customs actions).”  
Cadence/escalation: real‑time dashboard with automated Amber alerts (email/SMS) and Red escalations to Ops+Account within 30 minutes; I will publish the dashboard link and escalation contacts now.

I need to include a premium coverage statement, noting that Tier-1 SKUs fall under premium diversion and there are premium lanes for escalation, but I can't promise availability. I should clarify operational changes between Green and Amber statuses, like how Amber triggers a re-run optimizer, attempts diversions for Tier-1, and deploys temp labor. Each example should include ETA ranges and premium coverage statements, while also explaining operational changes. We will notify clients of any expected cost impacts for the premium lanes. Finally, for the closing, I’ll confirm contact details in case we escalate to Red and reiterate the timeline for revised ETAs.

Let's put together concise sentences for the update:

For the intro: "06-Sep 08:00 — A–C Textiles Promotion status: note that enhanced Lenton checks typically add about +1 day to transit for affected shipments, with a subset possibly seeing +2-day events during week 1. 

For Green: "Green — All clear: shipments are on track to the DC within agreed delivery windows, with Tier-1 SKUs on planned priority lanes and no premium substitutions or extra labor needed."

For Amber: "Amber — Lenton showing elevated delays: some shipments now expect +1 to +2 day ETA extensions; we’re re-running the optimizer, deploying temporary labor on flagged dates, and will request premium bookings as capacity allows."
